title: Ecological Scarcity 2021: sulfur dioxide at 12,000 UBP/kg; the FOEN report gives 8.3 UBP/g
datasets: Ecological Scarcity 2021, `Sulfur dioxide` to air (a method factor, not a dataset)
observation: The method in the release's openLCA package scores SO₂ at 12,000 UBP/kg in all four air compartments. The FOEN report (*Swiss Eco-Factors 2021 according to the Ecological Scarcity Method*) gives 8.3 UBP/g, and the method carries the report's values for the acids it scales from SO₂ by acidification potential (HCl 7,300, H₂S 16,000 UBP/kg). The workbook applies 12,000: of the 101 cumulative datasets with SO₂, 87 reproduce within 0.01 % at 12,000 and none at 8,300. Effect ×1.45 on SO₂. On the 87 cumulative datasets with SO₂ and no technosphere input, the difference is a median 3.3 % of `Main air pollutants and PM` (largest 10.9 %, `Anthraquinone, at plant`); on the 68 of them with unit kg, a median 3.4 % of that column and 0.2 % of `Total`. Is there an official factor list that says 12?
validation_scope: Factors read from the method in the release's openLCA package (12,000 UBP/kg in all four air compartments, read again on 6 November) and compared with the FOEN report; the workbook column recomputed on the 101 cumulative datasets with SO2. Exposure on the 87 with no technosphere input as measured in the lci-bafu-catalog ledger (!44), not repeated here. Filed 31 October 2026. Not yet re-measured by a second person.
next_action: Independent re-measurement (drop needs-triage), then send to BAFU with the next batch.
